name: Monitor Thingy
description: For those who can afford more monitors.

switch-monitor.name: Switch Monitor
switch-monitor.description: Press this key while the game is running to move it to the next monitor.

toggle-borderless.name: Toggle Borderless Fullscreen
toggle-borderless.description: Press this key to switch between borderless fullscreen and windowed mode.

move-windowed.name: Move Windowed Game
move-windowed.description: Also switch monitors when the game is not in fullscreen mode.

remember-monitor.name: Remember Monitor
remember-monitor.description: Remember the selected monitor and return to it after toggling fullscreen or restarting the game.

show-notification.name: Show Notification
show-notification.description: Show a short notification when the monitor has been switched.

switch-now.name: Test Switch
switch-now.description: Switch to the next monitor right now.
